scope: P08 real kernel UID recipient egress-FD quotas; development artifacts only
member_choice: Approved unrun fixture choice to reuse the frozen fairness collector; its singleton-body bytes/hash are not hay evidence
other_limits: Existing finite native defaults; config_file nil; XML queues must be nil
headroom: At each denied small call, peer FDs and peer/UID/global bytes/messages have spare capacity. UID denial is tested at global FD2; global denial at UID1101 FD1.
cleanup_schedule: Kill source and A1 before A1 original deadline; retain A2/B1 unread until natural normal DOWN within each original deadline plus cleanup_ms; drain EOF only after death
warmup: Actual memfd traffic through all three recipients and observer, use/close rights, close all five clients, capture exact empty warmed baseline, reconnect five workload clients
external_fd_oracle: At stabilized phase/health/afterkill checkpoints: warmed_empty_FDs + 2 * present_peers + active_outputs; memfds exactly active accepted serials; denial inventory unchanged

monitor_observer.scope: Independent BEAM monotonic receipt timestamp for DOWN; distinct from main consume time and not the exact kernel instant of death
monitor_observer.lifecycle: Start before warmed baseline; synchronous registration before workload writes; EOF stop under monitor and normal join
